title: How Quickly Can the DoD Rebuild and Recast the Munitions Industrial Base?
summary: This CSIS analysis examines the Department of Defense's ability to rebuild and transform its munitions industrial base, addressing critical questions about production capacity, supply chain resilience, and the timeline required to modernize defense manufacturing in response to current geopolitical challenges.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of assessing and accelerating the reconstruction of US munitions production capacity and industrial resilience.
why_valuable: Provides critical strategic insights for defense policymakers on rebuilding domestic munitions manufacturing capabilities amid growing global tensions.
